description:
About the job

Sobre Brother




Brother es una compañía global con más de 115 años de historia, reconocida por desarrollar soluciones innovadoras para el hogar, la oficina y la industria.

En Brother México, con más de 30 años de presencia en el país, trabajamos bajo nuestra promesa “At your side”, buscando simplificar y enriquecer la vida de nuestros clientes, colaboradores y comunidades.




Nuestra cultura está impulsada por cuatro comportamientos clave: Responsabilidad, Autenticidad, Audacia y Excelencia, promoviendo un entorno diverso, inclusivo y colaborativo.

Sobre la posición




Buscamos un/a Product Marketing Specialist que lidere el análisis, desarrollo y ejecución de estrategias de marketing para nuestro portafolio de productos L&M y SPS, trabajando de manera cercana con Ventas, canales comerciales y equipos regionales.




Esta posición combina estrategia de producto, análisis de negocio, pricing, gestión de portafolio y ejecución comercial, con el objetivo de impulsar el sell-out, la rentabilidad, la participación de mercado y el crecimiento de la categoría.




Principales responsabilidades

📊 Estrategia de producto y mercado

Analizar tendencias de mercado, competencia, posicionamiento y participación de mercado.
Desarrollar estrategias de producto y go-to-market diferenciadas por canal.
Gestionar el ciclo de vida del producto: lanzamientos, modelos actuales, transiciones y racionalización del portafolio.
Identificar oportunidades de crecimiento para productos y consumibles.
Participar en la definición de estrategias de lanzamiento, posicionamiento y comercialización.




📈 Business & Performance Analytics

Analizar sell-in, sell-out, inventarios, forecast, crecimiento y mix de producto.
Evaluar GP, rentabilidad, ROI y desempeño de productos, canales y acciones comerciales.
Monitorear precios, price protection, descuentos y fondos de marketing.
Identificar riesgos y oportunidades y desarrollar planes de acción.
Apoyar los procesos de Budget, Net Sales, GP y Forecast.




🤝 Sales & Channel Partnership

Trabajar directamente con el equipo de Ventas para definir y ejecutar estrategias que impulsen el sell-out.
Desarrollar estrategias diferenciadas para canales como D&D, Retail/OSS, Industrial/Telecom e Integradores.
Brindar soporte comercial y de producto a los equipos de ventas.
Realizar visitas de campo y mantener contacto con clientes para detectar oportunidades.
Desarrollar presentaciones, comparativos, brochures y herramientas comerciales.
Capacitar a clientes internos y externos sobre productos y estrategias comerciales.




🚀 Go-to-Market & Marketing Execution

Coordinar campañas y acciones de marketing orientadas a generación de demanda y crecimiento comercial.
Elaborar briefs y materiales de apoyo para ventas y puntos de venta.
Apoyar iniciativas de marketing digital, e-commerce, website, redes sociales y optimización de product pages.
Medir el desempeño de las iniciativas de marketing y proponer acciones de mejora.
Coordinar eventos y actividades para clientes en conjunto con los canales de ventas.




🌎 Colaboración regional y global

Mantener comunicación con equipos de Brother USA y Brother Japón para lanzamientos, estrategias de producto y desarrollo de materiales.
Coordinar traducciones, especificaciones técnicas, empaques y herramientas comerciales para nuevos productos.
Gestionar aprobaciones de precios y, cuando aplique, procesos de Tender Support.
Participar en viajes nacionales e internacionales relacionados con las actividades del área.




¿Qué buscamos?

Licenciatura concluida en Marketing, Administración de Empresas, Negocios o áreas afines.
Experiencia previa en Product Marketing, Marketing de Producto o posiciones similares.
Inglés avanzado, oral y escrito.
Sólido entendimiento de estrategias de Sell-In y Sell-Out.
Capacidad para analizar información comercial, financiera y de mercado.
Manejo avanzado de Excel y PowerPoint.
Experiencia trabajando de manera cercana con equipos de Ventas y diferentes canales comerciales.




Competencias clave

Buscamos una persona con:

Pensamiento analítico y estratégico.
Orientación a resultados y al negocio.
Capacidad para convertir datos en acciones comerciales.
Comunicación e influencia.
Planeación y organización.
Colaboración cross-functional.
Manejo efectivo de stakeholders.
Proactividad y sentido de ownership.




¿Por qué Brother?

Queremos que nuestros colaboradores puedan desarrollarse profesionalmente mientras mantienen un balance saludable entre su vida personal y profesional.

Entre nuestros beneficios y prácticas de trabajo encontrarás:

🏠Esquema híbrido de trabajo.
🩺 Seguro de gastos médicos y seguro de vida.
💰 Programa de ahorro y beneficios financieros.
👨 👩 👧 Beneficios y permisos enfocados en momentos importantes para nuestros colaboradores y sus familias.
📚 Programas y recursos de aprendizaje y desarrollo.
👕 Código de vestimenta casual.
📅 Días adicionales de descanso durante el año.
🚗 Estacionamiento en nuestra oficina de Santa Fe.




Nuestra cultura

Nuestra misión es cumplir nuestra promesa “At your side”, simplificando y enriqueciendo la vida de nuestros clientes, colaboradores y comunidades.




Nos guiamos por nuestros impulsores culturales — Responsabilidad, Autenticidad, Audacia y Excelencia — que definen cómo colaboramos, tomamos decisiones y generamos resultados.

📍 Nuestra oficina corporativa en México está ubicada en Santa Fe, Ciudad de México, y contamos también con colaboradores en otras ubicaciones del país.

Igualdad de oportunidades




Brother es un empleador que ofrece igualdad de oportunidades. Celebramos la diversidad y estamos comprometidos con construir un entorno inclusivo donde todas las personas sean respetadas y valoradas.




Damos la bienvenida a postulantes de todos los orígenes y no discriminamos por motivos de raza, género, edad, discapacidad, orientación sexual ni por cualquier otra condición protegida por la legislación aplicable.




¿Te interesa combinar estrategia de producto, análisis de negocio y colaboración comercial para impulsar el crecimiento de una marca global? Queremos conocerte.

title: Senior SEO, GEO, & AEO Specialist - Home Services
description:
About the job

About the Role




We are looking for a high-energy, technically strong SEO professional to join the marketing team of a Top 50 U.S. company in its home services category.




This is not a basic SEO execution role. We are looking for someone who understands traditional search optimization but is also actively adapting to the rapidly changing world of AI search, Generative Engine Optimization (GEO), Answer Engine Optimization (AEO), Google AI Overviews, ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, and other AI-driven discovery platforms.




You will work across SEO strategy, technical SEO, content, WordPress, analytics, local search, social content, on-page optimization, off-page authority building, and AI-assisted marketing Workflows.




The ideal candidate is a self-motivated self-starter who does not need constant direction, but is also an excellent communicator who works well with a fast-moving team.




We want someone who sees a problem, investigates it, develops a solution, communicates the plan, and gets it done.




Key Responsibilities

SEO Strategy & Execution

• Develop and execute comprehensive SEO strategies for a major home services brand.

• Perform keyword research, competitive analysis, SERP analysis, and opportunity

identification.

• Optimize service pages, location pages, landing pages, blogs, and other website content.

• Improve organic visibility for competitive local and regional home services searches.

• Monitor rankings, traffic, leads, conversions, and overall organic performance.

• Identify ranking declines, technical problems, algorithm impacts, and new growth

opportunities.

• Build scalable SEO strategies across multiple service areas and geographic markets.




GEO & AEO

• Develop strategies to increase brand visibility within ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews,

Gemini, Perplexity, Copilot, and other AI search platforms.

• Implement Generative Engine Optimization and Answer Engine Optimization strategies.

• Structure website content so AI platforms can easily understand, cite, summarize, and recommend the company.

• Improve entity authority, topical authority, structured information, and brand signals across the web.

• Research how competitors are appearing in AI-generated answers and identify

opportunities to outperform them.

• Stay current with changes in AI search and rapidly test new optimization strategies.




Technical SEO

• Conduct technical SEO audits and prioritize fixes based on business impact.




Work comfortably with:

o WordPress

o HTML

o CSS

o Schema markup

o Internal linking

o Canonicals

o Redirects

o Indexation

o XML sitemaps

o Robots.txt

o Site architecture

o Page speed

o Core Web Vitals

• Diagnose crawling and indexing issues.

• Work with developers to communicate and implement technical recommendations.

• Understand enough web technology to investigate issues independently instead of

relying entirely on developers.




WordPress & Website Optimization

• Work directly inside WordPress to update and optimize website content.

• Create and improve pages, headings, metadata, internal links, images, schema, CTAs, and page structure.

• Understand modern WordPress environments, plugins, themes, and page builders.

• Help maintain SEO quality across large numbers of service and location pages.




Content Strategy

• Develop content strategies around customer search behavior, topical authority, and

lead generation.

• Use AI tools to accelerate research, content briefs, outlines, optimization, competitive analysis, and production.

• Review AI-generated content critically rather than simply publishing AI output.

• Edit content for accuracy, originality, brand voice, search intent, readability, and

conversion.

• Identify content gaps and create recommendations for new service pages, location

pages, FAQs, articles, guides, and supporting content.




Local SEO

• Understand local SEO for multi-location and service-area businesses.

• Optimize Google Business Profiles and supporting local signals.

• Analyze local rankings and Maps visibility.

• Understand citations, reviews, proximity, relevance, prominence, and local authority.

• Help create scalable strategies for expanding visibility across multiple cities and markets.




Off-Page SEO & Authority

• Identify opportunities for backlinks, citations, PR mentions, partnerships, directories, industry publications, and digital authority.

• Evaluate backlink quality and competitive link profiles.

• Support digital PR and brand authority initiatives.

• Help strengthen the company’s overall entity and authority footprint across the web.




Social & Content Distribution

• Work with the content and social teams to identify opportunities where social content can support search visibility, brand authority, and AI discovery.

• Help repurpose website content into social and other digital formats.

• Understand how YouTube, social platforms, video, PR, and third-party mentions

contribute to modern search visibility.




Analytics & Reporting




We are looking for an analytics ninja who enjoys digging into data.




You should be comfortable using tools such as:

• Google Analytics 4

• Google Search Console

• Google Business Profile

• SEMrush

• Ahrefs

• Screaming Frog

• Looker Studio

• Keyword tracking platforms

• Call tracking and lead attribution tools

• AI research and analysis tools




You will be expected to go beyond reporting numbers.




We want someone who can explain:




What happened?

Why did it happen?

What should we do next?




You should be able to connect SEO activity to calls, leads, appointments, revenue, and

business growth, not simply rankings and traffic.




AI & Automation




AI will be a major part of this position.




You should already be comfortable working with tools such as:

• ChatGPT

• Claude

• Gemini

• Perplexity

• AI content tools

• AI research tools

• SEO automation tools




Experience with workflow automation platforms such as n8n, Zapier, Make, APIs, or similar systems is a major plus.




We are looking for someone who uses AI to become more productive, analytical, and creative — not someone who relies on AI to do their thinking for them.




Required Experience

• Minimum 5 years of professional SEO experience.

• Demonstrated success improving organic search performance.

• Strong understanding of technical SEO.

• Strong WordPress experience.

• Strong on-page SEO experience.

• Experience with off-page SEO and link acquisition.

• Strong keyword research and competitive research skills.

• Experience with analytics and reporting.

• Experience developing or managing SEO content.

• Understanding of local SEO.

• Strong written and spoken English.

• Comfortable working with AI tools.

• Comfortable learning new technologies quickly.




Home Services Experience Strongly Preferred




Experience working with industries such as:

• Roofing

• HVAC

• Plumbing

• Electrical

• Restoration

• Landscaping

• Tree services

• Pest control

• Remodeling

• Solar

• Garage doors

• Windows and doors

• Other local home service businesses is highly desirable




You should understand that home services SEO is ultimately about generating qualified phone calls, appointments, estimates, and revenue in specific geographic markets.




Who We’re Looking For




We want someone who is:

• Self-motivated

• A self-starter

• Highly organized

• Data driven

• Analytical

• Technically capable

• Curious

• Resourceful

• Fast moving

• High energy

• Detail oriented

• Accountable

• Comfortable taking ownership

• A strong communicator

• A collaborative team player




You should be comfortable being given an objective rather than a detailed checklist.




For example:

“Organic leads in this market are down. Figure out why and recommend what we should do.”




You should know how to investigate the problem, analyze the data, develop hypotheses, recommend solutions, and help implement them.




Communication & Availability




This is a full-time, dedicated position, not a freelance or part-time side project.




The person selected must be available during normal U.S. Central Time business hours and able to participate in:

• Team meetings

• Google Meet / video calls

• Strategy discussions

• Slack communication

• Client or internal calls when needed

• Screen sharing and collaborative problem solving




Strong communication is essential.




We do not want someone who disappears for hours and delivers work without context. We want someone who communicates progress, raises problems early, asks intelligent questions, and collaborates with the team.




Exclusive Full-Time Commitment




This position requires your full-time professional commitment during agreed working hours.




It is not designed for someone simultaneously managing a large portfolio of freelance clients, multiple full-time jobs, or another agency during the workday.




We are looking for someone who wants to become an important long-term member of the team and help build one of the strongest digital marketing operations in the home services Industry.




What Makes Someone Successful in This Role




You will succeed here if you naturally think:




“How can we improve this?”




rather than:




“What task am I supposed to do next?”




We value people who find opportunities without being asked, investigate problems deeply, experiment intelligently, measure results, communicate clearly, and take ownership of outcomes.




SEO is changing quickly.




We are looking for someone who understands traditional SEO deeply but is excited about where search is going next — and wants to help us stay ahead of it.

description:
About the job

Especialista en Campañas Publicitarias Digitales | Paid Media Specialist




¿Te apasiona el performance marketing, analizar resultados y convertir datos en decisiones que hagan crecer una marca?

En Boost Your Brand México buscamos un/a Paid Media Specialist con experiencia en planeación, implementación, optimización y análisis de campañas digitales para sumarse a nuestro equipo.

Trabajarás con marcas nacionales e internacionales de moda, lujo, skincare, beauty, wellness, hospitality y lifestyle, desarrollando estrategias enfocadas tanto en awareness como en performance y conversión.


Sobre Boost

Somos una agencia de Marketing Digital especializada en desarrollar y hacer crecer marcas a través de estrategia, creatividad, tecnología y medios digitales.

Trabajamos principalmente en:

Publicidad digital en Meta Ads, Google Ads, TikTok Ads y otras plataformas.
Estrategias de performance marketing
Branding y comunicación digital
Social Media
Ecommerce y desarrollo web
Generación de leads y estrategias de conversión
Análisis de resultados y optimización de Customer Journeys

Trabajamos con importantes marcas nacionales e internacionales dentro de las industrias de lujo, moda, belleza, skincare, wellness y hospitality.

Nos gusta trabajar en equipo, con objetivos claros, pensamiento estratégico y un enfoque constante en resultados.




Objetivo del puesto

Ser responsable de la correcta planeación, implementación, monitoreo y optimización de campañas publicitarias digitales para las diferentes cuentas de la agencia.

Buscamos a alguien que no solamente sepa operar plataformas, sino que pueda entender los objetivos de negocio de cada cliente, interpretar datos, detectar oportunidades y proponer estrategias para mejorar resultados.


Responsabilidades




Planear, implementar y administrar campañas de Paid Media para diferentes clientes de la agencia.
Gestionar campañas en Meta Ads, Google Ads, Tik Tok Ads, Open Table, entre otras.
Desarrollar campañas de awareness, tráfico, interacción, generación de leads, ventas y conversiones.
Implementar estrategias de remarketing y retargeting.
Administrar y optimizar presupuestos publicitarios.
Monitorear diariamente el desempeño de las campañas.
Optimizar campañas con base en objetivos y KPIs como:, ROAS, CPA, CPL, CAC, CTR, CPC, CPM, Conversion Rate, Revenue.
Realizar análisis de performance e identificar oportunidades de optimización.
Desarrollar estrategias de estructura de campañas, segmentaciones, audiencias y funnels.
Analizar resultados por audiencia, ubicación, plataforma, creatividad y etapa del funnel.
Trabajar en conjunto con los equipos de Marketing, Diseño y Cuentas para desarrollar campañas integrales.
Detectar qué formatos, mensajes y creatividades generan mejores resultados y compartir insights con el equipo creativo.
Elaborar reportes mensuales y presentaciones de resultados para clientes.
Traducir información técnica y métricas de campañas en recomendaciones claras de negocio.
Participar en reuniones con clientes para presentar resultados, oportunidades y nuevas estrategias.
Gestionar diferentes cuentas y campañas simultáneamente.
Mantenerse actualizado/a sobre nuevas herramientas, formatos, algoritmos y tendencias de Paid Media.




Plataformas principales




Dominio avanzado de:

Facebook Ads
Instagram Ads
Meta Business Manager
Events Manager
Audiencias personalizadas
Lookalike Audiences
Remarketing
Pixel y eventos de conversión
Advantage+ Campaigns
Campañas de Leads
Campañas de Ecommerce / Sales




Google Ads

Experiencia en:

Search
Display
Performance Max
Shopping
YouTube Ads
Remarketing
Keyword strategy
Conversion tracking




Deseable

Experiencia operando o conocimiento de:

TikTok Ads
LinkedIn Ads
Pinterest Ads
Programmatic
Amazon Ads

Licenciatura en Marketing, Mercadotecnia, Publicidad, Comunicación, Negocios o áreas afines.
2+ años de experiencia implementando y optimizando campañas digitales.
Experiencia comprobable manejando Meta Ads y Google Ads.
Experiencia gestionando múltiples cuentas y campañas simultáneamente.
Experiencia trabajando con presupuestos publicitarios y objetivos de performance.
Experiencia en campañas enfocadas a ecommerce, ventas y generación de leads.

Capacidad para interpretar información y tomar decisiones basadas en datos.

Excelente organización y seguimiento de tareas.

Analítica

skills: Plan, execute, and optimize Google Ads campaigns (Search, Display, YouTube), LinkedIn Ads and across the Meta Ads ecosystem (Facebook, Instagram, Audience Network) and marketing channels like ProspectBase and ComparaSoftware.
Design and develop multichannel acquisition strategies, integrating paid media, organic tactics, and automation.

Oversee the entire paid demand generation funnel, ensuring efficient conversion from first touch to closed deal.

Collaborate with product, sales, and content teams to align marketing goals with business growth.

Propose and implement A/B tests and growth marketing experiments.

Preferably proven experience in SaaS and B2B models, preferably within tech or digital services companies.
Strategic understanding of the 360° digital ecosystem: SEO, SEM, social media, email marketing, CRM, and automation.
Experience in lead generation and qualification within long sales cycles.
Advanced use of HubSpot: workflows, lead scoring, automation, and reporting.

Scrappy, defaults to action and comfortable operating in environments with ambiguous information to make decisions.

Intermediate to advanced English proficiency.
description:
About the job

We are Blip, a conversational AI platform for intelligent interactions which allows businesses to connect with customers at scale across multiple communication channels, such as WhatsApp, Instagram, Facebook,or webchat. Through AI we allow brands to gain scalability and directly impact key KPIs by accompanying the user throughout the customer journey with hybrid experiences combining automation and human interactions

At Blip, we have a team of Blippers who live and breathe innovation daily, bringing a unique perspective to evolving communication journeys, always with the confidence to keep learning! And at our own pace, we go much further! 🚀

Join us and be part of a team that’s shaping the future of intelligent customer interactions. Let’s go further, together! 🚀

Find out how you can make an impact with us!



We are looking for a Growth and Paid Media Sr Analyst with a strategic mindset and strong tactical execution skills, capable of leading digital acquisition campaigns with an omnichannel approach. This role will be key in designing, implementing, and optimizing performance marketing initiatives focused on generating qualified leads in SaaS and B2B environments.

The main responsibilities you will have are:




Plan, execute, and optimize Google Ads campaigns (Search, Display, YouTube), LinkedIn Ads and across the Meta Ads ecosystem (Facebook, Instagram, Audience Network) and marketing channels like ProspectBase and ComparaSoftware.
Design and develop multichannel acquisition strategies, integrating paid media, organic tactics, and automation.
Produce regular reports with actionable business insights.
Oversee the entire paid demand generation funnel, ensuring efficient conversion from first touch to closed deal.
Use HubSpot for campaign automation and performance tracking.
Collaborate with product, sales, and content teams to align marketing goals with business growth.
Analyze key metrics and generate actionable reports for continuous improvement.
Propose and implement A/B tests and growth marketing experiments.


What are the requirements?


3 to 5 years of experience in digital marketing roles, with a focus on growth and paid media.
Proficiency in the Google Ads, LinkedIn Ads and Meta Ads Manager ecosystems.
Preferably proven experience in SaaS and B2B models, preferably within tech or digital services companies.
Strategic understanding of the 360° digital ecosystem: SEO, SEM, social media, email marketing, CRM, and automation.
Experience in lead generation and qualification within long sales cycles.
Advanced use of HubSpot: workflows, lead scoring, automation, and reporting.
Strong analytical skills and a data-driven mindset focused on business metrics (CPL, CAC, ROAS, LTV).
A mindset geared toward experimentation, continuous improvement, and results.
Scrappy, defaults to action and comfortable operating in environments with ambiguous information to make decisions.


Is a Must if you have:


Certifications in Google Ads, LinkedIn Ads, Meta Blueprint, or HubSpot.
Basic knowledge of BI tools (Looker Studio, Tableau, etc.).
Intermediate to advanced English proficiency.

title: SEO Specialist
skills: Write, optimize, and publish service pages, city and neighborhood pages, and blog content that ranks and converts.
Own on-page optimization, including title tags, meta descriptions, headers, internal linking, and image alt text.
Keep content accurate to services, service areas, and offers, and refresh underperforming pages.
Improve site structure and technical health, including page speed, mobile usability, crawl errors, indexing, and redirects.
Manage and optimize Google Business Profile, including posts, photos, services, Q&A, categories, and business information.
Grow and maintain local citations and directory listings, keeping NAP information consistent.
Track local pack rankings across target service areas and act on opportunities to improve performance.
Support review generation and monitor review responses to strengthen local trust signals.
Build quality, relevant backlinks through outreach, local partnerships, directories, and digital PR.
Help build and maintain the content calendar around keyword opportunities, seasonality, and high-value services.
Conduct keyword and competitor research to identify content gaps and opportunities.
Track and report on rankings, organic traffic, and conversions using Google Analytics 4, Search Console, and rank-tracking tools.
Connect SEO performance to leads, calls, and revenue where attribution data is available.
Clearly communicate progress, results, and opportunities to the Marketing Lead.
2–4 years of hands-on SEO experience, ideally with local or home-services businesses.
Strong on-page and local SEO skills, with a solid working knowledge of technical SEO.
Proven content writing experience in clear, natural English.
Working knowledge of Google Business Profile, Google Analytics 4, Search Console, and SEO tools such as Ahrefs, SEMrush, or similar.
Real experience building quality links through outreach and partnerships rather than spam-based tactics.
Comfortable working independently, managing priorities, and communicating progress clearly across time zones.
Fluent written English is required, as this role produces published, customer-facing content.
Experience with WordPress or a similar CMS platform.
Familiarity with schema markup, Core Web Vitals, and basic HTML.
Experience marketing for HVAC, plumbing, electrical, or other trades.
Experience with service-area or multi-location SEO.
Higher local pack and organic rankings for priority services and service areas.

About the job

Job Title: SEO Specialist - (HR55118)

Location: Remote

Salary Range: 1500 - 2500 USD/month

Work Schedule: Monday to Friday; 9:00 AM – 6:00 PM







NOTE: INDEPENDENT CONTRACTOR POSITION







About the Company:

Sagan represents a growing residential home-services company. The company is focused on increasing local visibility, generating qualified leads, and turning organic search traffic into measurable business growth.




Position Overview:

The SEO Specialist will own the day-to-day work that grows organic visibility and turns local searches into booked jobs.




This is a hands-on execution role focused on website content, on-page and technical SEO, local SEO, link building, Google Business Profile optimization, and content marketing.




The SEO Specialist will work closely with the Marketing Lead and report on the metrics that matter, including local rankings, organic traffic, calls, and form fills.




Key Responsibilities:

Write, optimize, and publish service pages, city and neighborhood pages, and blog content that ranks and converts.
Own on-page optimization, including title tags, meta descriptions, headers, internal linking, and image alt text.
Keep content accurate to services, service areas, and offers, and refresh underperforming pages.
Improve site structure and technical health, including page speed, mobile usability, crawl errors, indexing, and redirects.
Manage and optimize Google Business Profile, including posts, photos, services, Q&A, categories, and business information.
Grow and maintain local citations and directory listings, keeping NAP information consistent.
Track local pack rankings across target service areas and act on opportunities to improve performance.
Support review generation and monitor review responses to strengthen local trust signals.
Build quality, relevant backlinks through outreach, local partnerships, directories, and digital PR.
Help build and maintain the content calendar around keyword opportunities, seasonality, and high-value services.
Conduct keyword and competitor research to identify content gaps and opportunities.
Track and report on rankings, organic traffic, and conversions using Google Analytics 4, Search Console, and rank-tracking tools.
Connect SEO performance to leads, calls, and revenue where attribution data is available.
Clearly communicate progress, results, and opportunities to the Marketing Lead.




Qualifications:

2–4 years of hands-on SEO experience, ideally with local or home-services businesses.
Strong on-page and local SEO skills, with a solid working knowledge of technical SEO.
Proven content writing experience in clear, natural English.
Working knowledge of Google Business Profile, Google Analytics 4, Search Console, and SEO tools such as Ahrefs, SEMrush, or similar.
Real experience building quality links through outreach and partnerships rather than spam-based tactics.
Comfortable working independently, managing priorities, and communicating progress clearly across time zones.
Fluent written English is required, as this role produces published, customer-facing content.




Nice-to-Haves: 

Experience with WordPress or a similar CMS platform.
Familiarity with schema markup, Core Web Vitals, and basic HTML.
Experience marketing for HVAC, plumbing, electrical, or other trades.
Experience with service-area or multi-location SEO.




What Success Looks Like:

Higher local pack and organic rankings for priority services and service areas.
Growth in organic traffic that turns into calls and booked jobs, not just visits.
A steady flow of quality content and clean, healthy website pages.
Clear, consistent reporting that connects SEO work to real business results.

¿Qué es DOVER?

DOVER es una agencia de medios de origen latinoamericano y alcance global que busca ir más allá de los medios tradicionales. Diseña estrategias que conectan el mundo físico y digital, combinando data, tecnología, creatividad y conocimiento de las personas para generar conexiones relevantes entre marcas y audiencias.

Trabajan con una visión integral de las campañas, desde la estrategia y planificación hasta su ejecución, monitoreo y análisis de resultados, con servicios de SEM, Social Ads, programática, CRM, influencers y estrategias Full Funnel.

¿Qué hace que Dover sea un lugar único?

Según nos ha contado el equipo de DOVER, lo mejor de trabajar aquí es:


🌱 Deja huella mientras el equipo crece: ayudarás a elevar el nivel del área y a impulsar el desarrollo de las personas.
🤝 Un equipo donde importan las personas y las perspectivas: diversidad, inclusión y experiencias diferentes forman parte de su manera de trabajar.
🎓 Mucho espacio para aprender y enseñar: compartir conocimiento y hacer crecer al equipo será tan importante como lograr resultados.


¿Cómo será tu equipo?

Formarás parte del equipo de Paid Media de DOVER, trabajando junto a otros especialistas encargados de operar las campañas digitales de los clientes.

Reportarás al Paid Media Manager y actuarás como su mano derecha, siendo el/la principal referente técnico del equipo. No tendrás personas a tu cargo de manera formal, pero sí un papel importante acompañando a perfiles más junior, resolviendo dudas, revisando su trabajo y ayudando a elevar el nivel técnico de la operación.

En el día a día trabajarás también de forma coordinada con otros perfiles y áreas de la agencia y, en las cuentas que lideres técnicamente, podrás participar en conversaciones con clientes para aportar la visión estratégica y especializada de Paid Media.

¿Cuál será tu misión?

Tu misión será convertirte en una referencia técnica dentro del equipo de Paid Media, asegurando que las campañas se creen, configuren y optimicen con precisión, consistencia y altos estándares de calidad.

Tendrás un rol muy hands-on en plataforma, pero tu impacto irá más allá de ejecutar campañas: también tendrás ownership técnico sobre algunas cuentas, participarás en el diseño de sus estrategias de Paid Media y ayudarás a detectar oportunidades, mejorar procesos, documentar buenas prácticas y acompañar técnicamente al resto del equipo.

Liderar técnicamente cuentas clave, asegurando que la estrategia y la ejecución de Paid Media respondan a los objetivos definidos para cada cliente.
Diseñar estrategias de Paid Media para las cuentas asignadas, definiendo el enfoque de canales y las líneas de acción más adecuadas en función de sus objetivos.

Ejecutar optimizaciones continuas en función de los objetivos de performance definidos por el Paid Media Manager, priorizando las acciones según su impacto en resultados, inversión, eficiencia y oportunidad de negocio.
Analizar el rendimiento de las campañas a través de KPIs clave: inversión, CPC, CPM, CTR, CPA, CPL, ROAS, conversiones, revenue, frecuencia y tasa de conversión.
Detectar problemas y oportunidades de mejora relacionados con performance, tracking, configuración o estructura de campañas, convirtiendo el análisis en acciones concretas de optimización.
Identificar patrones, aprendizajes y oportunidades entre diferentes cuentas, documentando los cambios relevantes, hipótesis de optimización y aprendizajes obtenidos.
Actuar como referente técnico para traffickers y perfiles más junior, revisando configuraciones, optimizaciones, análisis y propuestas y dando feedback práctico y orientado a la mejora.
Acompañar el desarrollo técnico del equipo, resolviendo dudas operativas y compartiendo buenas prácticas, novedades de plataformas y aprendizajes relevantes, sin asumir la gestión formal de personas.
Apoyar al Paid Media Manager aportando una lectura técnica sobre el performance y la evolución de las campañas.


¿Qué están buscando? 

Buscamos una persona con una base muy sólida y hands-on en Paid Media, capaz de moverse con autonomía en plataforma, analizar resultados con criterio y convertirse en un referente técnico para otros miembros del equipo.

Dominio avanzado de Google Ads y Meta Ads; así como en TikTok Ads, LinkedIn Ads, Pinterest Ads, Microsoft Ads y compra programática.

description:
About the job

PinPoint Analytics is an AI-powered public works data and bid intelligence platform. We organize and analyze real bid results to help contractors price against the market, help civil engineering firms create market-aligned project estimates for municipal clients, and help public-sector teams reduce the risk of over-budget bids, rebids, and avoidable project delays. Civil engineering firms are among our largest customers.




Position Overview

We are hiring Sales Development Representatives to build the top of our sales funnel as we expand across the United States. You will cold-call small and mid-sized US businesses, open conversations with people who have never heard of us, qualify initial fit, and book meetings for our Account Executives — who then run discovery, demonstrations, and the close.




This is a high-volume, high-velocity outbound role. Our AEs win many deals around a $20,000 annual price point with small and mid-sized civil contractors, not a few seven-figure enterprise contracts. That means your job is measured in conversations started and qualified meetings booked, not in nurturing a handful of accounts.




You do not need to know anything about construction, estimating, or public works bidding to apply. We provide full product and market training after you are hired. What we cannot train quickly is the ability to hold a cold conversation with a busy, skeptical business owner in English and earn thirty seconds of their attention.




This role is fully remote for candidates based in Latin America, working United States business hours.




What You Will Own

Make consistent daily outbound cold calls to owners, estimators, and managers at small and mid-sized US contractors and civil engineering firms.
Open cold conversations with a short, relevant hook — and keep control of the call without being pushy.
Qualify initial fit against a clear, trainable set of criteria before booking anything.
Book qualified meetings for Account Executives and hand off clean, useful context so the AE can prepare.
Work a curated target list built with Sales Enablement and Sales Operations, and feed back what you learn so the list keeps improving.
Supplement calling with email and LinkedIn follow-up in a disciplined, repeatable cadence.
Log every call, contact, and outcome in HubSpot with clean, current data.
Handle the same objections dozens of times a day and keep getting better at them.
Report on your own activity and conversion honestly, including what is not working.




A Day in the Life

Work United States business hours with your target territory, from a reliable home office with stable internet and a quiet calling environment.
Make a high volume of dials against a targeted list — expect calling to be the majority of your day.
Research accounts and contacts before dialing so the opening line is relevant rather than generic.
Book and confirm meetings, then make sure prospects actually show up.
Join a short daily team sync and regular coaching sessions where calls are reviewed and the pitch is refined.
Collaborate with AEs, Sales Enablement, and leadership in a fast-paced, early-stage environment.




Must Haves

Professional English fluency — you will spend your entire day on the phone with US business owners in English, handling interruptions, objections, and fast conversational turns.
1+ years of B2B outbound experience: cold calling, SDR/BDR, telesales, or a comparable phone-based prospecting role.
A demonstrable record of hitting activity and meeting-setting targets, with real numbers you can speak to.
Comfort with rejection and the resilience to keep dialing after a string of hang-ups.
Coachability — you take direct feedback on a call and apply it on the very next one.
Discipline with CRM hygiene and follow-up cadence (HubSpot experience is a plus, not a requirement).
Based in Latin America, able to work United States business hours consistently.
A reliable computer, stable high-speed internet, and a quiet, professional calling environment.




Nice to Haves — Backgrounds That Stand Out

None of these are required. Each strengthens a candidacy, and combinations stand out even more:

Outbound experience selling into the US market, especially to small and mid-sized businesses or owner-operators.
SaaS or technology prospecting experience, particularly where the buyer was not already looking for the product.
Experience selling into construction, trades, industrial, logistics, equipment, or other blue-collar and field-based industries.
Experience in bid-driven or public-sector-adjacent markets, where customers win revenue through competitive bidding.
A track record of promotion from SDR into a closing role — we want people who want that path.
Experience with HubSpot, Salesforce, Outreach, Apollo, ZoomInfo, or similar prospecting and CRM tooling.




Does This Sound Like You?

You are energized rather than discouraged by a hard cold call. You would rather have twelve real conversations than send two hundred emails into the void. You take initiative instead of waiting to be told what to do, and you are honest about your numbers — including the bad weeks. You want to learn a specialized industry deeply, and you see the SDR seat as the first step toward closing, not as the destination.




Compensation & Benefits

This is a full-time independent contractor engagement (not employment). Compensation is structured as base pay plus performance bonus, paid monthly in USD; there is no separate benefits package (health insurance, paid time off, etc.), and contractors are responsible for their own local tax obligations.

Base pay: $1,500–$2,000 USD per month, paid monthly in USD, commensurate with experience.
Solid bonus structure on top of base, tied to key performance indicators — call activity, qualified meetings delivered, and net-new ARR generated — each weighted according to role priorities.
We reward strong performers generously.
Fully remote, working United States business hours.
Full product and market training, plus ongoing call coaching.




Screening Process

Submit your application and resume.
Complete a structured English voice screen with role-play; you may ask to repeat a question, skip it, or request a human alternative at any point.
Advance to a human interview with sales leadership.

Our screening process evaluates listening comprehension, clarity, call control, objection handling, and coaching response. It does not evaluate accent, pronunciation, native-speaker status, age, background, or personality stereotypes. Human reviewers make all hiring decisions.




How to Apply

Apply through this posting. Shortlisted candidates will be invited to complete a short phone interview with our screening assistant. Company website: pinpointanalytics.ai.

About the job

Descripción de la empresa Haulsa Logistics es una empresa de logística fundada en Monterrey, Nuevo León, en 2015, especializada en soluciones de transporte terrestre nacional e internacional. Ofrecemos un servicio personalizado apoyado en tecnología, lo que nos permite mantener una comunicación continua 24/7 con nuestra clientela. The YouTube Partner Program engages millions of content creators — a group that’s growing quickly, and will grow even faster in the coming years. The Scaled Partnerships team focuses on driving partner and product success at scale by acquiring, managing, and growing partners. The team spans acquisitions and partnerships to drive outcomes across all partner types and all verticals. In this role, you grow in a fast-paced environment, and you are building a working understanding of YouTube internal processes, products, and teams. You support your team in deepening relationships with key partners and creators, helping them optimize and adopt features, enabling YouTube to be successful. You are developing your skills in relationship-building, negotiation, project management, and collaboration, focusing on tasks that contribute to your team's and organization's goals.

Establish scaled strategic relationships with partners through different engagement types.

title: Customer Success Manager
description:
About the job

Customer Success Manager - Job Description




Our client is the all-in-one experience intelligence platform designed to be easily used by anyone who cares about digital journeys. With flexible and scalable platform, organizations quickly get a deep understanding of their customers’ whole online journey.




Our client is a global leader in the experience analytics space, having secured $1.4 billion in funding and expanded to 15 offices worldwide.




About the job

As a member of Mid-Market Customer Success team, you will be instrumental in maximizing customer lifetime value and driving revenue growth within a multi-million dollar book of business of post-sales customers. You will be responsible for building lasting relationships – with executives, front-line leadership, and platform end users alike – from kickoff to renewal via ongoing strategic guidance that demands executive alignment on goals and value and supports change management, mutual accountability to execution, strong adoption, value realization, and customer satisfaction. This role will necessitate partnering closely with a large cross-functional team - including members of Implementation, Enablement, Customer Experience, Sales, and Product - to ensure the customer is supported at every stage of their journey.




What you’ll do :

● Relationship Management: Develop and maintain a trusted advisor relationship with key customer stakeholders & executive sponsors

● Executive Alignment: Demonstrate an intimate and aligned understanding of the customer - their business, opportunities, challenges, objectives, and overall data maturity Prepare and lead strategic meetings with executive leadership that advance customer maturity and adoption

and drive actionable and measurable outcomes and partnership success

● Drive Value: Align all partnership activities with key business objectives and measurable value outcomes, continuously demonstrating and communicating the value realized of our solutions to end users and buying committee

● Customer Advocacy: Act as the main point of contact and advocate for customers internally

● Program Management: Collaborate cross-functionally with other departments across the customer lifecycle, ensuring partnership and renewal success

● Success Planning: Hold regular calls with customers to help them strategize best how to use the product(s) to achieve their goals and drive joint accountability to execution to realize success

● Subject Matter Expert: Contribute to the customer’s digital CX strategy and optimization roadmap, answer questions relating to product usage, and keep customers informed of company's news and product updates

● Renewal Management/Commercial Strategy: Drive renewals to successful completion in close collaboration with Sales to achieve gross retention targets while owning the renewal process for ‘low growth’ accounts, developing and executing strategies to ensure high renewal rates and minimize churn

● Upsell Identification: Collaborate with Sales teams to identify and drive growth opportunities contributing to upsell targets

description:
About the job

About Lendable

Lendable is on a mission to build the world's best technology to help people get credit and save money. We're building one of the world’s leading fintech companies and are off to a strong start:

One of the UK’s newest unicorns with a team of just over 700 people
Among the fastest-growing tech companies in the UK
Profitable since 2017
Backed by top investors including Balderton Capital and Goldman Sachs
Loved by customers with the best reviews in the market (4.9 across 10,000s of reviews on Trustpilot)




So far, we’ve rebuilt the Big Three consumer finance products from scratch: loans, credit cards and car finance. We get money into our customers’ hands in minutes instead of days.

We’re growing fast, and there’s a lot more to do: we’re going after the two biggest Western markets (UK and US) where trillions worth of financial products are held by big banks with dated systems and painful processes.




Join us if you want to

Take ownership across a broad remit. You are trusted to make decisions that drive a material impact on the direction and success of Lendable from day 1
Work in small teams of exceptional people, who are relentlessly resourceful to solve problems and find smarter solutions than the status quo
Build the best technology in-house, using new data sources, machine learning and AI to make machines do the heavy lifting




About The Role

We’re looking for a Senior PHP Engineer based in Mexico to help grow Lenda, our credit card product for the Mexican market.

You’ll join a small, cross-functional team with a startup mindset, backed by one of Europe’s most successful and profitable fintechs. You’ll play a key role in scaling a new product, with significant ownership and the opportunity to shape how we build from an early stage.

We’re looking for an experienced, resourceful engineer who can collaborate across Product, Backend and Frontend, leverage learnings from our established products, shape API and technical decisions, and work closely with stakeholders to deliver customer value quickly.




Our tech stack

We believe in using the right tools for the job, and our stack reflects our commitment to modern, efficient development:

Backend: PHP 8, Symfony, AWS, PostgreSQL, RabbitMQ, Docker, Kubernetes
CI/CD: Datadog, GitHub Actions and ArgoCD
Testing & Monitoring: Behat, PHPUnit for robust automated testing, Datadog for monitoring
Productivity: Github, Slack, Jira & Confluence




What We're Looking For

We're seeking passionate engineers who are excited to contribute and grow with us

Must have:

Based either Mexico or willing to relocate to Mexico
Must have strong English language skills (written and spoken)
High degree of ownership and autonomy
Strong, business oriented, engineer with modern PHP development experience (PHP 8.0+ is a must). You're fluent in the latest PHP features and best practices.
A solid grasp of a modern PHP framework like Symfony or Laravel.
Experience with Domain Driven Design, Message-Driven Systems, Event Sourcing and CQRS
Excellent automated testing skills (unit, integration, functional) - you believe in quality code.
A genuine desire to learn, collaborate, and contribute your ideas within a highly collaborative team.




Nice to have:

Familiarity with microservices architecture and working on financial systems is a bonus.
You have experimented with AI tooling to accelerate your own, and others, productivity, and can discuss the positives and negatives of different approaches and tools
Experience in a cross-functional environment.




Interview process

Short video call with one of our team members to learn more about each other, and answer any initial questions you have about the role
Cognitive Assessment
Technical session with your peers where you’ll discuss your solution to the exercise, talk through some problems and scenarios, and dig deeper into your technical experience
Culture interview to explore your motivations and goals, assess how you could play a part in your team’s success, and better understand how we could help you thrive in your role.




Life at Lendable

Winning team: the opportunity to scale up one of the world’s most successful fintech companies

Summary

Fluent English required (C1/C2 level)

Overview

Can you spot a creator with commercial potential and then turn that potential into actual brand revenue? Nouvel Age Media is looking for a Creator Partnerships & Talent Manager to help us build and grow our creator representation and brand partnerships division from the ground up.




This is not a traditional influencer marketing role where you're handed a campaign brief and asked to find creators for a brand. You'll be responsible for building both sides of our creator partnerships network: talent and brands.




On the talent side, you'll identify and recruit creators with strong commercial potential, build relationships with them, understand their audiences and goals, and position them for relevant paid opportunities.




On the brand side, you'll identify companies that are actively investing in creator partnerships, build relationships with the right decision-makers, pitch our talent, and turn those conversations into paid brand deals.




Nouvel Age Media will sit at the center—connecting the right creators with the right brands while managing the commercial relationship, negotiations, communication, and partnership process.

That means we aren't looking for someone who only knows how to coordinate influencer campaigns.




We need someone commercially sharp who understands creator representation, can build relationships on both sides of the market, is comfortable prospecting and pitching brands, can negotiate confidently, and knows how to turn relationships into revenue.




You'll initially focus on building a curated roster of high-potential creators and generating consistent partnership opportunities for them, with the goal of eventually managing 20+ revenue-generating creators.







Here's What You'll Dive Into

Creator Recruitment & Representation: Identify, evaluate, recruit, and onboard creators with strong audience quality, content, engagement, professionalism, and commercial potential.
Brand Partnership Development: Identify and build relationships with brands seeking creator talent and proactively generate paid opportunities that connect the right creators with the right brands.
Outbound Business Development: Research relevant brands and decision-makers, conduct targeted outreach, pitch creators and partnership concepts, and consistently build a pipeline of potential brand deals.
Creator Positioning: Help creators strengthen their commercial positioning through media kits, rate cards, audience profiles, partnership packages, and other brand-facing materials.
Partnership Strategy: Identify brands, categories, campaigns, and opportunities that align with each creator's audience, niche, content, and goals.
Deal Negotiation: Negotiate rates, deliverables, timelines, usage rights, exclusivity, licensing, whitelisting, and other commercial terms.
Talent Management: Serve as the primary business contact for represented creators and help them navigate opportunities, negotiations, partnerships, and long-term monetization.
Partnership Management: Serve as the bridge between creators and brand partners, managing communication from initial introduction and negotiation through campaign execution, payment, and renewal.
Revenue Growth: Grow monthly brand-deal revenue across the creator portfolio and turn one-off sponsorships into recurring brand relationships.
Division Development: Help build the processes, systems, relationships, and infrastructure required to scale Nouvel Age Media's creator partnerships business.







Accountabilities

Build the Creator Roster: Recruit a curated portfolio of creators with genuine commercial potential rather than focusing solely on follower count or roster size.
Build the Brand Network: Develop a growing network of brands and decision-makers actively investing in creators, influencers, sponsorships, and social partnerships.
Generate Partnership Pipeline: Consistently create new brand-deal opportunities through outbound prospecting, relationships, referrals, inbound opportunities, networking, and other channels.
Own Creator Monetization: Be accountable for generating brand partnership revenue across the creators you represent.
Prospect Strategically: Research brands and decision-makers that align with individual creators and develop relevant outreach that earns conversations.
Pitch Talent: Confidently communicate why a creator, audience, or campaign concept is relevant to a prospective brand and translate that fit into a commercial opportunity.
Match Creators & Brands: Understand both sides of the partnership well enough to identify opportunities that make strategic and commercial sense for the creator and brand.
Manage the Partnership Pipeline: Maintain visibility into prospects, conversations, pitches, proposals, negotiations, expected deal values, close dates, and partnership status.
Negotiate & Close: Own commercial conversations and negotiate partnership terms that protect creator value while maintaining healthy economics for Nouvel Age Media.
Manage Creator Relationships: Build strong, trusted relationships with represented creators and maintain clear communication around opportunities, expectations, timelines, and performance.
Manage Brand Relationships: Deliver a professional experience for brand partners before, during, and after each campaign.
Drive Repeat Business: Turn successful one-time partnerships into recurring campaigns, ambassador relationships, sponsorships, and longer-term brand deals.
Expand Existing Relationships: Identify opportunities to connect additional creators from our roster with existing brand partners.

title: Channel Sales Manager
description:
About the job

Impulsar el rendimiento del sell-through de EZVIZ en el mercado mexicano mediante el desarrollo y la gestión de cuentas clave de retail, la optimización de la ejecución en tienda y la aceleración de la rotación de inventario desde el punto de venta hasta el consumidor final, alcanzando al mismo tiempo los objetivos de sell-out, participación en anaquel (shelf share) y rentabilidad en todo el portafolio de productos de EZVIZ (CCTV, Smart Home, Smart Lock y dispositivos IoT relacionados).




Responsabilidades Clave:




• Desarrollar y gestionar relaciones de sell-through con cuentas clave de retail y los principales canales comerciales a nivel nacional.

• Ejecutar planes de sell-through en tienda, incluyendo la colocación de material POP/POS, estándares de exhibición en anaquel y activaciones promocionales para maximizar la visibilidad del producto.

• Monitorear datos de sell-out, niveles de stock y disponibilidad en anaquel con los socios comerciales; resolver proactivamente brechas, desabastos (stockouts) y producto de lenta rotación (dead stock).

• Construir y mantener relaciones sólidas con compradores de retail, gerentes de categoría y equipos de operaciones en tienda para asegurar apoyo promocional y espacio en anaquel.

• Impulsar campañas de sell-through en retail y promociones comerciales; realizar el seguimiento del ROI y reportar los resultados a la dirección.

• Coordinar con distribuidores y equipos de logística para garantizar el reabastecimiento oportuno de productos y un flujo constante de inventario hacia los socios comerciales.

• Elaborar pronósticos (forecasts) de sell-through, reportes de desempeño semanales/mensuales y planes de visitas al territorio.

• Apoyar en la capacitación de producto para el personal de retail y socios del canal con el fin de mejorar el conocimiento de la marca y del producto.

• Viajar extensamente por el territorio para visitar cuentas clave de retail y asegurar los estándares de ejecución en campo.

• Colaborar con los equipos de Marketing, Ventas en oficinas centrales (HQ) y distribuidores para alinearse en promociones, lanzamientos de productos y objetivos de sell-through.




Experiencia Requerida:

• Más de 3 años de experiencia en sell-through, trade marketing o gestión de canales de retail dentro de las industrias de CCTV, Smart Home, electrónica de consumo, redes o seguridad.

• Trayectoria comprobada en el impulso del desempeño de sell-out en cuentas clave de retail.

• Amplia experiencia en la gestión de las principales cadenas de retail y canales comerciales en México.

• Sólidas habilidades de negociación, gestión de cuentas y presentación.

• Competencia en el análisis y reporte de datos de sell-out (por ejemplo: tasas de sell-through, rotación de inventario, participación en anaquel).

• De preferencia, experiencia en la gestión de portafolios completos de productos.




Perfil Preferido:




• Residencia actual en México.

• Relaciones establecidas con las principales cadenas de retail que operan en México (por ejemplo: Home Depot, Costco, Liverpool, Soriana, OXXO, Elektra, Sanborns, Chedraui, etc.).

• Profundo conocimiento del panorama del retail mexicano, los canales comerciales y el comportamiento del consumidor.

• Familiaridad con las dinámicas del mercado regional en los diferentes estados de México.

• De preferencia, experiencia previa trabajando con fabricantes y marcas internacionales.




Competencias:




• Mentalidad comercial

• Excelencia en la ejecución de retail

• Toma de decisiones basada en datos

• Comunicación y gestión de partes interesadas (stakeholders)

• Planeación y priorización

• Orientación a resultados

• Trabajo en equipo y colaboración multifuncional




Disponibilidad para Viajar:




De 70 a 80% de viaje por todo México (cobertura nacional).




Criterios de Selección Importantes.




Se dará prioridad a los candidatos que ya estén establecidos en México, cuenten con una red activa en el sector de retail y tengan la capacidad de ejecutar de manera inmediata tras su incorporación.

Present Snowflake technology and vision to executives and technical contributors at Snowflake customers and prospects

Immerse yourself in the ever-evolving industry, maintaining a deep understanding of competitive and complementary technologies and vendors and how to position Snowflake in relation to them.
Collaborate with Product Management, Engineering, and Marketing to continuously improve Snowflake’s products and marketing.



ON DAY ONE WE WILL EXPECT YOU TO HAVE:


Outstanding presenting skills to both technical and executive audiences, whether impromptu on a whiteboard or using presentations and demos.
Broad range of experience within large-scale Database and/or Data Warehouse technology, ETL, analytics and cloud technologies
Hands-on expertise with SQL and SQL analytics
Ability to understand a customer’s specific business problems and translate these to Snowflake use cases
University degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics or related fields, or equivalent experience preferred
Travel Required



 ABOUT OUR TEAM:

Our Solution Engineers are customer obsessed and we believe in the value we can add and stay honest about it. We love to learn, are open to giving and receiving feedback and are passionate about making our clients successful. Our team works to ensure data is accessible, usable and valuable to everyone.

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

About the job

Senior Amazon Seller Central Manager – Remote

This is a full-time, long-term remote position open to qualified candidates. If hired this position must be your only job as it is full time and we strickly prohibit job stacking. Please read job post carefully and follow directions below to be considered. You will not get an interview if you don't follow our direction listed below.




About the Role

Tiffand is seeking an experienced Amazon Seller Central Manager to help manage and grow our Amazon business. This is a hands-on position for someone with deep, practical experience working inside Amazon Seller Central, particularly within the United States marketplace.

The right person will take ownership of day-to-day Seller Central operations, identify opportunities and problems without waiting to be told, and follow issues through to resolution. We need someone who is equally comfortable working with flat files, troubleshooting catalog problems, analyzing performance, managing inventory, and coordinating listing improvements.

This is not an entry-level Amazon VA, customer service, PPC-only, or freelance position. You must have substantial hands-on experience managing Seller Central operations and independently resolving problems.




Primary Responsibilities

Manage day-to-day operations within Amazon Seller Central
Create, optimize, and maintain product listings
Make catalog updates using category-specific flat files and bulk-upload templates
Troubleshoot listing, variation, contribution, attribute, and catalog issues
Open and manage Seller Support cases through resolution
Work within Amazon Brand Registry
Monitor Account Health and help resolve policy or compliance issues
Investigate and resolve hazmat classification and restricted-product issues
Prepare FBA shipments and provide shipping labels and documentation to suppliers
Monitor inventory and help determine replenishment and reorder needs
Record incoming inventory and purchase order information in our systems
Identify and resolve stranded, suppressed, and inactive inventory
Create SKUs according to established company naming conventions
Monitor pricing and manage repricing
Review reimbursement opportunities and manage reimbursement cases
Analyze Amazon business reports and translate findings into specific actions
Identify opportunities to improve traffic, conversion, sales, and profitability
Verify that requested listing and catalog changes are implemented correctly
Maintain accurate documentation and project information in Google Drive

Brand and Listing Development

Conduct listing audits and competitive research
Research customer reviews and voice-of-customer information
Recommend improvements to titles, bullet points, descriptions, images, and backend content
Coordinate with our graphic designer on product images, A+ Content, Brand Stories, and other creative assets
Create or help create A+ Content, Brand Stories, comparison charts, and image alt text
Assist with advertising analysis and coordinate with advertising specialists when necessary
Monitor listing performance after changes are made

Additional Responsibilities

Amazon will be the primary focus of this position. Additional responsibilities may occasionally include:

Basic eBay order and listing management
Basic Walmart order and listing management
Recording business expenses and maintaining operational records
Working within Google Workspace
Project management and other administrative tasks directly related to marketplace operations

Required Qualifications

At least three years of hands-on Amazon Seller Central experience
Extensive experience managing Amazon accounts in the United States marketplace
Strong knowledge of Amazon flat files, bulk uploads, and upload-processing reports
Experience creating and modifying listings, variations, and catalog attributes
Experience preparing FBA shipments and managing inventory
Experience working with Seller Support and resolving complicated account or catalog issues
Working knowledge of Amazon Brand Registry
Good understanding of Amazon policies and the ability to keep up with policy changes
Strong analytical skills and experience using Amazon business reports
Advanced proficiency with Google Sheets/excel and Google Drive
Excellent written and Fluent spoken English, including professional grammar
Strong attention to detail and the ability to verify completed work
Excellent troubleshooting and problem-solving skills
Ability to prioritize work, manage multiple projects, and operate with limited supervision
A reliable computer, internet connection, and professional remote-working environment

Experience with PPC, Account Health, reimbursements, eBay, or Walmart is helpful, but deep Seller Central operational experience is the priority.




The Person We Are Looking For

You may be a strong fit if you:

Take ownership of problems and follow them through to completion
Investigate why something happened instead of applying only a temporary fix
Know when to use a flat file instead of making changes manually
Can interpret Amazon reports and recommend specific improvements
Communicate clearly when you encounter a problem, need a decision, or complete a project
Are comfortable working independently while collaborating with a remote team
Treat the Amazon account and the brands we represent with care and accountability
Want a stable, long-term position with the opportunity to grow




Schedule and Employment Expectations

This position requires eight+ working hours per day and consistent overlap with our U.S.-based team.

Your established schedule must fall within our operating window of 6:30 a.m. to 8:00 p.m. U.S. Central Time. The specific eight-hour schedule will be established before hiring.

This position must be your only full-time job. All ongoing employment, freelance clients, businesses, or recurring work commitments must be disclosed before hiring. Undisclosed simultaneous full-time employment or job stacking is not permitted and may result in immediate termination.




Compensation and Growth

Competitive monthly salary based on experience and demonstrated ability
Performance-based bonuses
Stable, long-term employment
Career growth and increasing responsibility
Supportive and collaborative remote-working environment

We have a proven history of building long-term relationships with strong team members.




How to Apply

Email your résumé to info@tiffand.com with the exact subject line:

Senior Amazon Seller Central Manager

In the body of your email, briefly include:

Your current location
Your english level proficiency
The number of years you have worked directly in Amazon Seller Central
The Amazon marketplaces you have managed
Confirmation that you are available for a full-time position and can work for us and only us.
Confirmation that you are comfortable working an evening or overnight schedule aligned with U.S. Central day Time

A formal cover letter is not required. We want a brief and honest description of your actual experience. Applications that do not follow these instructions may not be considered.




About Tiffand

Tiffand, established in 2017, is a growing U.S.-based e-commerce company. We sell physical consumer products directly to customers and partner with select brands to manage, promote, and sell their products on Amazon.

Our work includes marketplace operations, listing optimization, inventory management, advertising, creative development, and brand growth. We have a history of building long-term relationships with strong team members.

Learn more at www.tiffand.com.

title: Creative Strategist
description:
About the job

Join the team turning ad creative into pipeline revenue for local businesses.




Hey, g'day, mabuhay, kia ora, hola, hallo, vítejte!




Thanks for stopping by. We know job hunting can be a little time consuming and you're probably keen to find out what's on offer, so we'll get straight to the point.




We're Goat Media. We film creative ads, script them strategically, run paid campaigns, and drive qualified leads into our clients' pipelines. If it doesn't drive revenue, it doesn't get done. That's not a tagline, that's the operating system.




We need a creative strategist to be the engine behind our ad creative and client fulfillment. That's where you come in.




Responsibilities 

Content Strategy & Scripting

Develop the content strategy for each client based on their business, their audience, their pain points, and their goals. Write scripts for face-to-camera videos, short-form content, and any other format we deploy. Every script has a purpose, a hook, a message, and a reason it exists on the platform it's going to.

Platform Distribution Thinking

You understand that YouTube is not Instagram is not TikTok. You know what works on each platform, what format each one rewards, what posting cadence makes sense, and why posting the same video everywhere without adaptation is lazy and ineffective. You think about distribution before you write a single word.

Creative Angle Development

Generate new messaging angles based on client business data, customer insights, competitor research, and platform trends. Build and maintain swipe files using tools like Meta Ad Library, Google Ad Library, and competitor research tools. You're always hunting for the next angle that could crack open a client's growth.

Creative Briefs

Own the briefing process end-to-end. Write clear, specific briefs for videographers, editors, and any other production resources. A brief that leaves room for interpretation is a brief that produces the wrong content. You eliminate ambiguity.

Performance Analysis

Work closely with our media buyers to understand what's performing and what's not. Look at ad performance data, engagement metrics, and platform analytics to inform your next round of creative. You don't guess, you read the data and adjust. You understand creative testing methodologies and you know that only a small percentage of creatives will actually scale.

Client Content Calendars

Build and maintain content calendars for each client. Plan content weeks ahead, not day-of. Ensure every piece of content has a strategic reason for existing and maps to a business outcome the client cares about.

Market & Competitor Research

Stay current on platform algorithm changes, content trends, and what competitors in each client's space are doing. Use that intelligence to keep our clients ahead, not reacting.




The type of creative

We don't want boring contractor ads that sound like every other company. We want ads that make people stop scrolling and actually want to watch.

Think interesting hooks, storytelling, UGC-style videos, before and afters, customer mistakes, educational content, "things nobody tells you" angles, cost breakdowns, contractor tips, humor, curiosity-driven ideas, and problem/solution content.

You should know what makes content go viral and why people stop scrolling. You understand the psychology behind why someone watches a video to the end versus swiping past it in two seconds. You study consumer behavior, buyer behavior, and human psychology because you know that great advertising is applied psychology, not guesswork.




Qualifications

English C1 or higher. All scripts, briefs, and client-facing communication will be in English. You need to write at a level that reads naturally, not like a translated second language.




5+ years experience in this role or a similar creative strategy, copywriting, or advertising role. You've been in the trenches. You know what a good ad looks like because you've written hundreds of them and watched the data come back.




Deep understanding of copywriting, advertising, and consumer psychology. You know why people click, watch, engage, and buy. You understand buyer behavior and human psychology because you've studied it, not because you read one book on it. You know what makes content go viral and you can explain the mechanism behind it, not just point to a trend.




Strong social media understanding. You know why certain content formats perform on certain platforms, how algorithms reward different behaviors, and how to adapt a single piece of content across multiple platforms without just copy-pasting.




Knows the big advertisers and the greats. You follow the people who are actually moving the needle in advertising. You study their work, you understand why it works, and you're not stuck in 2015 direct response thinking.




Hungry and wants to learn about advertising. You're not here to clock in, do your hours, and disappear. You're genuinely obsessed with getting better at this craft. You're the type who watches ad breakdowns for fun and gets excited about a new angle that cracks open a campaign.




Winner mindset. You take feedback well and you're always looking to improve. You're not precious about your creative. You don't write generic or corporate-sounding copy. You're comfortable coming up with ideas without being told exactly what to do. You're a creative thinker who's passionate about marketing.




Team player. You work well alongside media buyers, editors, and videographers. You communicate clearly, you take ownership, and you don't throw your work over a wall and hope for the best.




Creative testing mindset. You understand that most creatives won't scale, and you're comfortable with that. You know how to test systematically, read results, and iterate without emotional attachment to your work.




Can research and understand new industries quickly. Every client is in a different space. You need to be able to drop into a new industry, understand the customer, the pain points, the language, and the competitive landscape fast, then write ads that sound like you've been in that industry for years.




About The Company

We're Goat Media, a paid advertising company built on one principle: revenue-driven actions. If something isn't bringing revenue, there's zero point in doing it.

We film creative ads for local businesses (nationwide), script them strategically, and run paid campaigns that drive qualified leads into our clients' pipelines. We're not a social media management agency that posts content and hopes for engagement. We're a performance company that ties every ad, every script, and every dollar of spend to revenue coming back through the door.




Other Details

Location: Remote 

Type: Full-time 

Compensation: $2,500 to $3,000/month

Schedule: Monday to Friday, aligned to US time zones
